title: OpenDEA Assessment Dimension
description: A recursively composable assessment taxonomy node (CR-AM-05A §3). A sub-dimension is simply a Dimension with a parent Dimension — there is no SubDimension class (§40). Arbitrary depth is permitted (AC-AM05A-02); the hierarchy is directed and acyclic (§8, validated by runtime/instruments). The Dimension hierarchy organizes the assessment; it is not the Capability hierarchy (§5).

name.description: Display name. Changing the name does not change identity (§8: stable identity).

parent_dimension.description: The parent Dimension. Absent = root dimension (§3). A Dimension has at most one parent and may have many children.

capabilities.description: Capabilities organized under this Dimension (§10). One Dimension may organize several capabilities; one Capability may be relevant to multiple Dimensions. Capability is not a subtype of Dimension (AC-AM05A-04).

criteria.description: Criteria attached to this Dimension (§11). A Criterion is the semantic bridge between evidence and maturity.

maturity_scale.description: Optional per-Dimension maturity scale override (§28). Default remains the parent model's canonical scale unless explicitly overridden.
